MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH p.position AS position,
     2026 - CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) -
     CASE
       WHEN CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) > 10
         OR (CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(SPLIT(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) > 14)
       THEN 1
       ELSE 0
     END AS age
RETURN position AS col1, AVG(CAST(age AS DOUBLE)) AS col2
